name: wizteros
description: Dev/test tooling for the stripe-bridge paid-access stack

scripts.setup:py: python3 -m venv venv && venv/bin/pip install -r stripe-bridge/requirements-dev.txt
scripts.verify: run-s lint format:check typecheck test:web test:bridge
scripts.bridge:up: docker rm -f stripe-bridge-e2e >/dev/null 2>&1; docker run -d --name stripe-bridge-e2e -p 8000:8000 --env-file .env -v "$PWD/stripe-bridge/data:/data" stripe-bridge
scripts.test:unit: docker run --rm -v "$PWD/stripe-bridge:/app" -w /app stripe-bridge sh -c 'pip install -q pytest responses >/dev/null 2>&1 && python -m pytest -q'
